# Revix System

> Multi-branch car rental & fleet operations ERP platform by Revix Mobility.

Revix System helps car rental companies and fleet operators manage their entire lifecycle in one unified workspace: vehicle assets, purchase orders, rental contracts, booking calendars, pricing, customers (CRM), inter-branch movements, drivers, insurance policies, and multi-currency branch finance.

## Key Public Pages

- [Home](https://system.revixmobility.com/): Platform overview, capabilities, integrations, plans, and FAQ.
- [About Revix](https://system.revixmobility.com/about): Company background, mission, and supported operating models.
- [Contact](https://system.revixmobility.com/contact): Support and sales contact details (`support@revixmobility.com`).
- [Terms of Service](https://system.revixmobility.com/terms): Service terms and conditions.
- [Privacy Policy](https://system.revixmobility.com/privacy): Data handling and privacy commitments.
